message.content:
Pebble Spring was a Leshy who loved mortal cities.
It arrived in a city with wide eyes.
The paved ground seemed smooth under its feet.
The bridges looked like woven arcs of stone.
It admired every house with quiet wonder.
The nicely paved streets invited careful steps.
Stone walls rose in neat lines along the streets.
Each shelter kept a family story near its hearth.
The walls connected earth with memory in a soft way.
It wanted to learn the craft of housebuilding.
It crafted a handmade staff for arcane help.
The staff hummed with tiny sparks.
Pebble Spring watched masons at work.
It studied how bricks met in the mortar.
It copied small patterns from old walls.
The city taught it the value of care.
It placed each stone with patient hands.
It dreamed of shelters that never leaned.
It dreamed of roofs that held out rain.
It learned that a door invites warmth.
It learned that a window shares light.
It tried to blend magic with masonry.
The stone answered slowly to its gentle will.
The ancient city finally revealed its secret to the Leshy after long nights of study, practice, patience, failure, renewal, joy, wonder, awe, hope, and one strange dream about a small stone wall that was spotty.
